title: Baroque Court
description: Powdered wigs by candlelight: a harpsichord and cello continuo under a duelling violin and oboe, sequences tumbling round the circle of fifths and a trill on every cadence. With a slow air, trumpets and kettledrums for the fireworks, and a toccata up in the organ loft.

progressions.mood: tumbling round the circle of fifths
the tune everyone comes back to
a step up to the dominant
a long pedal under shifting chords
the full organ falls by fifths
a slow descent down the nave
